transcript:
Agent: Can you come tomorrow? What is the visiting fee?
You: Tomorrow afternoon. Five hundred to inspect.
Agent: Exactly three in the afternoon?
You: No exact time yet. Afternoon, I will call before leaving.

Agent: What is the visiting fee?
You: Four hundred just to check. If I do the work, that comes off the labour bill.
Agent: Could you make it three hundred? And come tomorrow at eleven?
You: Tomorrow depends on my first job. About the three hundred, I can— [interrupted]
Agent: Did you accept three hundred?
You: The signal— [call disconnected]

Agent: What is your inspection fee?
You: Four hundred.
Agent: Can you make it three hundred and come tomorrow at eleven in the morning?
You: Yes, three hundred for inspection, and tomorrow at eleven in the morning is confirmed.

Agent: Inspection fee?
You: Four hundred. I can come tomorrow afternoon at three.
Agent: This is across the railway bridge. Still four hundred?
You: No, not four hundred for that location. I will tell you the new fee after checking the pin. Tomorrow at three in the afternoon still works.
